message: My dinner set (ORD-1060) still hasn't arrived and it's been more than three weeks.

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C009' AND order_id = 'ORD-1060'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C009'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Order ORD-1060 (Ceramic Dinner Set, Home) was ordered 2026-10-01, shows delivery_date null and delivered false, and 24 days have passed since the order date, exceeding R4's 14-day not-received window (E1). The $95.00 total is under the $200.00 auto-approve limit, the item is not final sale, the order has not already been refunded, and the customer has no prior refunds in the last 90 days (E1, E2).

critique.reason: All factual claims are supported by evidence ids and agree with the Python checks: E1 confirms ORD-1060 ordered 2026-10-01, delivery_date null, status shipped, $95.00 total, Home category, not final sale; checks confirm delivered false, 24 days since order, over_auto_limit false, already_refunded false, approved_refunds_last_90_days 0. E2 confirms no prior refunds. E3 contains R4's 14-day not-received window and $200 auto-approve limit; 24 days exceeds 14 and $95 is under $200, so R4 auto-approve applies and R7/R8/R10 do not trigger.

customer_reply: I'm sorry to hear your Ceramic Dinner Set still hasn't arrived. Since it's been 24 days since your order on October 1st, you can choose a full refund or a replacement. Please let me know which option you prefer.
limitations: No carrier tracking details beyond the order status were available for verification. The refund is processed separately by RefundWise, and no payment timing is promised.
